profile.description: Ransom County Fair in Lisbon will celebrate its 75th annual fair August 25–29, 2027. Its family program combines extensive 4-H and livestock participation, public exhibits, carnival days, rodeo, food, and Kids Day activities. The vendor page still displayed 2026 applications as of August 31, 2026, so the 2027 vendor/attraction application opening remains unconfirmed.

notes.subject: 2027 prospect research — reviewed August 31, 2026
notes.body: The official fair homepage confirms the 75th Annual Ransom County Fair for August 25–29, 2027 and lists Genene Aabrekke as secretary. HAFFE describes a strong family program with roughly 190 4-H members, livestock and static exhibits, public exhibits, carnival days, rodeo, food, and Kids Day activities. The official vendor page still showed only 2026 applications, so no 2027 application opening is confirmed. Sources: https://ransomcountyfair.com/ and https://ransomcountyfair.com/vendors

notes.subject: EMAIL DRAFT — review only; do not send
notes.body:
Subject: Ransom County Fair — August 25–29, 2027 — Adventure Zone

Hi Genene,

It was great meeting you through the HAFFE convention. Congratulations on the 75th Annual Ransom County Fair coming up August 25–29, 2027. With the fair’s strong 4-H and livestock program, carnival, rodeo, and Kids Day activities, The Adventure Zone could be a great addition to the family experience.

We bring a fully staffed inflatable bounce house carnival, with setup, operation, and teardown included. We can discuss a prepaid package or, where appropriate, a pay-for-play arrangement. Would you be open to a short conversation about your 2027 family entertainment plans and the right vendor or attraction process for us?

Best,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone
America’s Best Inflatable Bounce House Carnival

followUps.label: Review 2027 Ransom County Fair outreach
followUps.reason: The fair is confirmed for August 25–29, 2027. Check whether 2027 vendor or attraction forms have replaced the 2026 forms, then review the prepared email for Genene Aabrekke; do not send automatically.
